title: DOJ Issues Grand Jury Subpoena to James Comey Confidant Daniel Richman
summary: The subpoena of Daniel C. Richman is the latest move in a persistent campaign to go after James B. Comey, one of President Trump’s most reviled political adversaries who has already been indicted twice.
